options.name: auth
options.description: Authentication parameters. Can define each of them with ENV as well.

options.name: check
options.description: Name of the check associated with this event. It must exist before event creation.

options.name: check_attributes
options.description: Additional check parameters. Find out more at U(https://docs.sensu.io/sensu-go/latest/reference/events/#check-attributes).

options.name: entity
options.description: Name of the entity associated with this event. It must exist before event creation.

options.name: metric_attributes
options.description: Metric attributes. Find out more at U(https://docs.sensu.io/sensu-go/latest/reference/events/#metric-attributes).

options.name: namespace
options.description: RBAC namespace to operate in. If this is not set the value of the SENSU_NAMESPACE environment variable will be used.

options.name: timestamp
options.description: UNIX time at which the event occurred.
